changelog: - **CI, deploy and bot output no longer name a tenant or the marketing hosts, and a forbidden-terms guard keeps such names out** (#2919). The marketing content check no longer compares the served `<title>` with a hard-coded brand. A page's `<title>` must now contain the `name` in its host's own `/manifest.webmanifest`, and that name must be neither `Internship CRM` nor the `coreCRM` fallback. The same rule runs in `scripts/marketing-content-probe.mjs` (uptime), `infra/deploy-prod.sh` and `infra/server/topic-deploy.sh` (both warn-only). The new `infra/test/marketing-title-check.test.sh` keeps the three copies in step. `uptime.yml` reads the marketing URLs from the `MARKETING_PROBE_URLS` secret, skips them with a notice when it is unset, and names a host only by its number. The deploy checks print neither the title nor the manifest name. The topic-preview comment says "Marketing world", `android-build.yml` builds only the generic app, and `build-image.yml` no longer uploads Docker build records. New: `scripts/check-forbidden-terms.mjs` + `forbidden-terms.yml`. The guard takes its list only from the `FORBIDDEN_TERMS` secret and prints locations, never matches. It blocks a PR that adds a match (lines, file names, commit messages, branch, title, body), and scans the whole tree on `main` and daily, warn-only for now.
